integrity: The proof, definitions and finite verifier are fully included; computational checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes common fixed Parikh vector across an unordered multiset of words; perfect multiplicity-preserving complete length-(n-1) prefix and suffix reads. title: Necklace-parity factorization for fixed-content pooled longest-read reconstruction
